question: Complete the sentence: I went scuba diving last year. ___.
options: It was one of the best experiences of my life
I didn't use to like spicy food.
explanation: 'It was one of the best experiences of my life' (Это был один из лучших опытов в моей жизни). Full sentence: I went scuba diving last year. It was one of the best experiences of my life.

question: Which word means 'вход'?
options: Do you know if there's a bank near here?
explanation: 'entrance' means вход. Example: The entrance is on the left side of the building.

question: Which word means 'нервничающий'?
options: No, I've never… but I'd love to
explanation: 'nervous' means нервничающий. Example: He always gets nervous before presentations.
